claims: Binding-energy double differences, 2+ energies, ESPE and electromagnetic observables provide complementary shell-closure diagnostics.
Weak binding and continuum coupling change radial wavefunctions, resonance centroids, widths and Thomas-Ehrman shifts.
28O, 32Mg and 29F require configuration mixing, pairing, quadrupole correlations and many-body continuum treatment.
42Si oblate E2 maps, 60Ca shell-gap/intruder competition and 78Ni double-jj magicity are model-experiment interfaces rather than standalone mode confirmations.
